theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    dsimp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp [Fin2ToF2, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have he (k : Fin 2) : P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val =
      P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    dsimp only [P_i]
    rw [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, hq]
  have hp : P_i_plus_1.eval y.val =
      (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, eval_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C]
    rw [mul_sum, mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  change P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
  rw [he 0, he 1, hp]
  calc
    _ = ((1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val) *
        (x₁.val - x₀.val) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hd, mul_one]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    dsimp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1,
      add_sub_cancel_right]
  have he (k : Fin 2) : P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val =
      P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    dsimp only [P_i]
    rw [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, hq, P₀, P₁]
  have hp : P_i_plus_1.eval y.val =
      (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C]
    rw [mul_sum, mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    ring
  change P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
  rw [he 0, he 1, hp]
  calc
    _ = ((1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val) *
        (x₁.val - x₀.val) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hd, mul_one]

  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y

  let x₁ := fiberMap 1

  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs

    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm

    dsimp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1,
      add_sub_cancel_right]
  have he (k : Fin 2) : P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val =
      P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    dsimp only [P_i]
    rw [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, hq, P₀, P₁]
  have hp : P_i_plus_1.eval y.val =
      (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]

    P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
  rw [he 0, he 1, hp]
  calc

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    dsimp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1,
      add_sub_cancel_right]
  have he (k : Fin 2) : P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val =
      P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    dsimp only [P_i]
    rw [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, hq, P₀, P₁]
  have hp : P_i_plus_1.eval y.val =
      (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
  rw [he 0, he 1, hp]
  calc
    _ = ((1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val) *
        (x₁.val - x₀.val) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hd, mul_one]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hd : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    dsimp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1,
      add_sub_cancel_right]
  have he (k : Fin 2) : P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val =
      P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    have hq := (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
    dsimp only [P_i]
    rw [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, hq, P₀, P₁]
  have hp : P_i_plus_1.eval y.val =
      (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
  rw [he 0, he 1, hp]
  calc
    _ = ((1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val) *
        (x₁.val - x₀.val) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hd, mul_one]

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y

    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1

  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)

    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl

    P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    dsimp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1,
      add_sub_cancel_right]
  have hp : P_i_plus_1.eval y.val =
      (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [x₀, x₁, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, hq]
  calc
    _ = ((1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val) *
        (x₁.val - x₀.val) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hd, mul_one]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    dsimp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add]
    rw [get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate]
  have hp : P_i_plus_1.eval y.val =
      (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
      Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [x₀, x₁, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, eval_comp, hq]
  rw [hd]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    dsimp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _

  simp only [x₀, x₁, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  rw [hd]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    dsimp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add]
    conv_lhs => enter [1]; rw [get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
    rfl
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
    P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [x₀, x₁, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  rw [hd]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let x₀ := fiberMap 0
  let x₁ := fiberMap 1
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : x₁.val = 1 + x₀.val := by
    dsimp only [x₁, x₀, fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval x₀.val * _ + P_i.eval x₁.val * _ = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [x₀, x₁, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  rw [hd]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    dsimp only [fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  rw [hd]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h.symm
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    dsimp only [fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  rw [hd]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h.symm
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [fiberMap]
  rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y 1,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y 0]
  simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h.symm
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [fiberMap]
  rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y 1,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y 0]
  simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte]
  rw [one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h.symm
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [fiberMap]
  rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y 1,
    qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y 0]
  simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at h
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h.symm
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl

  rw [hp]

    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq

  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]

    Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
    evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
  simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul,
    Polynomial.eval_C, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_assoc, ←mul_sum]
  ring

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>

    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Nat.sub_add_eq, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  rw [hp]
  simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ (by omega)]
  ring1

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  simp only [hp, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring1

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  simp only [hp, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  have hx : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  rw [hx]
  ring1

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  simp only [hp, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  dsimp only [fiberMap]
  simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring1

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  simp only [hp, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring1

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  simp only [hp, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  have hf k := congrArg Subtype.val (qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y k)
  simp only [Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1] at hf
  simp only [fiberMap, hf, Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_smul]
  ring1

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  simp only [hp, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]

    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
      zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  rw [hf]
  ring1

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  have hq k := congrArg Subtype.val
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap] at hq
  have hp : P_i_plus_1 =
      Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs +
      Polynomial.C r_chal * oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs := by
    dsimp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, mul_assoc]
    rfl
  change P_i.eval (fiberMap 0).val * _ + P_i.eval (fiberMap 1).val * _ = _
  simp only [hp, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, eval_comp, hq]
  simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
    Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul,
    zero_smul, zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  ring1
